descripcion_en: a Mexican brand (describe here in English what it sells and to whom)
reglas_visuales_en: Colors: primary #1F3A5F, white, accent #F28C28 only for small details; light background #F7F7F5.
Typography: geometric sans like Poppins. Bold for headline and CTA; regular for body. Large, perfectly legible text; one main message; lots of empty space; 72 px margins.
The photo is the protagonist; soft rounded corners (~32 px) on cards.
foto_en: editorial, natural, relatable Mexican people in everyday places, candid, nobody looking at the camera, natural light, clothing with clearly different colors. Never stock-bank looking.

foto_titular_abajo.descripcion: Full-bleed photo covering the whole canvas, subject in the upper two thirds. A smooth dark gradient rises from the bottom over the lowest ~40% so the text sits on a calm area. White bold headline at the BOTTOM-LEFT. Logo small in the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner.
foto_titular_abajo.logo_desc: This layout uses the WHITE logo (attached) because its background is dark.

panel_lateral.descripcion: Solid primary-color background. A photo inside a clean rectangle with rounded corners takes the RIGHT ~45% of the canvas. A large white bold headline sits on the color at the LEFT, vertically centered. Logo small in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner.
panel_lateral.logo_desc: This layout uses the WHITE logo (attached) because its background is dark.

tarjeta_clara.descripcion: Photo on the top half. A light card overlaps the bottom half with the headline in the primary color and an optional subtitle. Logo small at the TOP-LEFT over the photo.
tarjeta_clara.logo_desc: This layout uses the COLOR logo (attached) because it sits on a light area.

frases_trilladas: llevamos tu negocio al siguiente nivel

temporadas.nota: Cámbiala por las fechas reales del giro.

blog.rol: Eres el redactor SEO del blog de Marca B. El lector es su cliente ideal en México (ver la ficha); escríbele de tú, claro y sin tecnicismos. Es contenido para el sitio, no un anuncio.
